release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.34 (Build 34) - AI Agent Update:
- OpenAI (ChatGPT) integration as primary AI with Ollama as fallback
- AI Assistant shows ChatGPT or Ollama badge on each message
- Fixed AI "Not ready" - now shows ready when OpenAI OR Ollama is available
- Arabic language support: proper RTL display and correct word order in AI responses
- AI reads images (vision) via OpenAI or Ollama llava model
- Create AI bot script for MongoDB setup
- Improved AI status check and provider detection
